name: Mage Armor

header.Components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Touch willing unarmored creature; base AC option 13+DEX; ends if recipient dons armor; eight hours, no Concentration; retain other legal base-AC choices.

rules.text: You touch a willing creature who isn’t wearing armor.
Until the spell ends, the target’s base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier.
The spell ends early if the target dons armor.
